description.value: The Masthead Restaurant is a waterfront dining destination in Cowichan Bay on Vancouver Island, historically known for seafood and regional cuisine in a harbour-side setting. It sits along the Vancouver Crossing Loop route, making it a potential stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cowichan Valley. Its current operating status is unclear based on prominent closure notices on its website.
